head: hex, double-circle headmark
notes: Caliper mount / half-shaft flange bolt. One vendor quote ties size to GM number; a CorvetteForum post says Paragon lists the caliper bolt as 7/16-20x1-1/8 (no GM number in snippet).

sources.quote: 1965-1982 CORVETTE REAR BRAKE CALIPER MOUNTING BOLT KIT, GM PART # 3843384, Includes 4 bolts and washers. ... Rear caliper mounting bolt kit, "Double Circle" headmark, 7/16-20 1 1/8" includes 4 bolts and washers.

sources.title: Caliper Bolt question - CorvetteForum
